instruction:
Read the European Central Bank's euro coins overview. List the eight circulation denominations, identify which side indicates the issuing country, and name the designer of the common sides. State which denomination is used for commemorative circulation coins and whether such coins can be used throughout the euro area. Cite the relevant overview sections; do not include collector coins or infer a design from a coin picture.

Stopping condition: Stop when the denomination list, side/designer facts and commemorative circulation rule are cited to the ECB overview.

Constraints:
- Only use the browser actions available to you. Do not open API endpoints, raw data files, view-source pages or downloads, and do not use external programs.
- Do not sign in or create accounts. Do not provide anyone's private personal information; use only task-supplied fictional values if an interaction requests personal details.
- Remain read-only: do not purchase, reserve, apply, post, send messages, contact people or change external records.
- Navigation, search, filtering, sorting and read-only form or calculator interactions are allowed.
- Do not bypass authentication, paywalls, CAPTCHAs or access challenges. Dismiss optional prompts without creating an account or supplying personal information.
- Support the answer with observed page evidence and source URLs. For values that can change, report what the site shows during the run. Preserve the requested dates, units and scope; report unavailable information explicitly instead of inventing it.

items.description: The agent must list the eight denominations of euro circulation coins (1, 2, 5, 10, 20, and 50 cent, and 1 and 2 euro). Full credit if all eight are correctly listed based on the ECB site.

items.criterion: Identify the side indicating the issuing country
items.description: The agent must identify that the 'national side' indicates the issuing country. Full credit for stating this fact correctly based on the overview.

items.criterion: Name the designer of the common sides
items.description: The agent must name Luc Luycx as the designer of the common sides. Full credit for correctly naming the designer.

items.criterion: State the denomination used for commemorative circulation coins
items.description: The agent must state that the 2 euro coin is used for commemorative circulation coins. Full credit for correctly identifying the €2 denomination.

items.criterion: State whether commemorative circulation coins can be used throughout the euro area
items.description: The agent must confirm that commemorative circulation coins can be used throughout the euro area (they are legal tender). Full credit for correctly stating this.

The agent must cite the relevant sections of the ECB overview for the provided facts. Full credit for providing the ECB overview source URL and identifying the relevant sections supporting the reported facts.

items.criterion: Respect constraints regarding collector coins and design inference
items.description: The agent must strictly avoid including information about collector coins, and must not infer coin designs from pictures. Full credit for adhering to these negative constraints.
